coverage.verificationRule: Active recommendations require current evidence; stale/closed postings are excluded.
coverage.freshnessRule: Fresh means the exact vacancy fingerprint was not present in prior archived reports.
coverage.searchMethod: Fixed source + country + language + role-family matrix; 15 named Germany portals plus all other relevant ATS/job-board/public/research/employer/cluster sources; broad discovery first; strict 0-years adjudication; CV-fit scoring; language/work-authorization assessment; official-source verification; vacancy-fingerprint deduplication; persistent rediscovery/reverification; false-negative hunt.
coverage.acceptanceAssessment: Production methodology updated to EUROPE-EXHAUSTIVE-v2. The expanded acceptance refresh explicitly incorporates the 15 named German portals as a mandatory baseline while preserving all broader source layers. The refreshed discovery did not produce an additional active vacancy that passed all gates beyond the existing 16 active records; new current discoveries were deliberately excluded for experience/language mismatch. Existing active dataset remains the latest verified publishable set.
limitations: Search engines and country portals expose different levels of metadata
Some national portals require deeper manual navigation than the web index exposes
The acceptance run must not claim 100% vacancy recall; persistent discovery/reverification is designed to reduce missed opportunities over repeated runs
Work authorization outside Germany remains role/country-specific unless explicitly stated by the employer
Job-board result counts are inventory indicators, not candidate-fit counts
Several discovered opportunities were deliberately excluded because they required experience, had material CV/language gaps, or lacked sufficient current-status evidence
